items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report, good to go MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams for MNF vs Eagles; Tyson Bagent questionable after full practice.
items.implication: Bagent likely start; Bears offense downgrade

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip); Rapoport notes not expected to play Sunday, Adams can carry load.
items.why: ETR Friday list + RapSheet video; hip/groin, no practice
items.opportunity: Adams primary WR target share increase

items.text: Nico Collins OUT (hamstring). Confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Schultz target share jumps (30% routes last week w/o him)
items.opportunity: Schultz TE upside vs Colts TE-friendly D

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT (toe). Steelers coach: Jaylen Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Toe, no practice; coach comments on rotation
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns from Rodgers

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite Q tags. Seeking early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/Moore.
items.why: ETR sims/projections as of Saturday; LP for some
items.implication: Start them if projected; monitor inactive

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow); not IR, week-to-week, Mariota starts. Positive imaging per Schefter/Rap.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin still viable historically but matchup caution

items.text: Key INs: JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Malik Nabers, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price (among others).
items.implication: Full roles expected; reverse prior handcuff beneficiaries if any

items.text: With Dowdle out, projecting Jaylen Warren as lead + heavy checkdowns; Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups. Vertical game failing for Rodgers.
items.why: Coach: Warren leads, breathers as needed; usage data focus
items.implication: High floor/ceiling RB2+ via volume + checkdowns

items.text: Post-fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Pats snaps 65% and out-touched Stevenson 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but ranks Stevenson still ahead Week 3.
items.why: Snap/touch data after Stevenson fumble; pass pro trust issue for Henderson
items.implication: Henderson rising but Stevenson preferred short-term

items.text: With Nico Collins out last week, Dalton Schultz targeted on 30% routes, 28% team target share. Faces Colts allowing 4th-most TE yards.
items.implication: Strong TE start/stream with Collins out again

items.text: Alec Pierce and Jonathon Brooks OUT.
items.implication: Colts WR depth or other targets up; Carolina RB to Hubbard/others

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 main slate.
items.why: Sim-based ceiling; projections live and updating

items.text: Drake London in 12 career games w/ Penix: >20 PPR, 35% TS, 97 rec yds/game.
items.implication: Elite WR1 ceiling if Penix starts
